During the operator-troubleshooting replay another agent's project (openlaw-docs-d029r21-lc-upgrade) rebuilt and retagged openlaw-local:57e77e38, so later container recreations in the diag project used image sha256:79ac46d4f838. Only the Compose project label differs.

keyObservations: Backup steps 1-5 ran as written on 57e77e38: pg_restore --list 684 TOC entries, tar listed 4 files, SHA256SUMS written, restart gave readiness, a Contract read and a matching Version hash, and the retained copy passed sha256sum --check.

Restore into openlaw-docs-d029c2-lcbr-restore on 127.0.0.1:23332: the target database had 0 tables and the volume 0 entries, pg_restore --exit-on-error exited 0, tar restored 4 files, and the target became ready.

Administrator, Legal Team Member and the former Contributor (now Business User) signed in through the browser. Contract, Matter, Entity and Field values matched, all four Version hashes matched, the Confidential Contract and its Document were refused to lower-access accounts, and portal reach stayed on the member Contract only.
A new PDF reached text ready, and a test email through the restored saved relay reached the controlled recipient.

Wrong valid-length OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY: Contract read 200, email source unset, test send 502 'The test email could not be sent. SMTP is not configured — save a relay first.', nothing delivered, and the log named 'No configured key opens these stored credentials: smtp_url (1)'. The retained key restored delivery.

A removed blob left the Document listed with download HTTP 500. Reapplying the retained file archive restored both Version hashes. With OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY removed, docker compose config --quiet and up both exited 1.

None of them changed, so the key refusals, the reconciled log line, 'This database cannot apply the migrations it is missing', the 0060_account_issuer refusals and the storage and worker rows keep their basis.

The other commits change Settings list editing, locked default Field display and archived-user styles. The article states nothing about them.
articles.conclusionReason: No statement, command, quoted message or recovery in the article changed. Every replay step passed on 57e77e38.

replay.phasesNotRun: diag-live-retry was a round 2 retry of a fault injection that did not take. diag-proxy already uses the corrected buffering and gzip fault, and it passed on the first run.
keyObservations: Upgrade from d1d098ba to 57e77e38 logged 'migrations: reconciled 0090_onboarding_reviewed_types; continuing with pending migrations'.

Missing AUTH_SECRET or OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY: config and up exited 1 and no container changed. A short OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY passed config, but app and worker restarted with 'OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY is shorter than 32 characters'. A short AUTH_SECRET only logged the better-auth warning.

PORT on an occupied port: up exited 1 with 'port is already allocated', ps --all showed app created and worker created, plain ps did not list them, and the same up command after correcting PORT gave readiness. An unused port with BASE_URL updated gave sign-in through that origin.
An unreachable DATABASE_URL made the app restart with a connection error. Stopped Postgres gave /healthz 200 and /readyz 503. Both recovered with a record read and write.

Journal fault: 'This database cannot apply the migrations it is missing.' and both read-only commands ran. The shipped 0060_account_issuer.sql refused with 'Cannot resolve an issuer for accounts under provider(s): doc029-retired-idp' and 'Two accounts share one 1.7 identity', left no issuer column, and applied on the corrected shape.

SMTP_URL pin: source env, delivery from SMTP_FROM, save refused 409. Removing it restored the saved relay. Wrong valid-length key: source unset and exactly 'The test email could not be sent. SMTP is not configured — save a relay first.', with a Contract read and a download still working.

Storage: volume owned by uid 1000 (node). Wrong S3 endpoint: /readyz 200, Document listed, download 500. Missing bucket: upload 500 with the app ready. Both recovered with matching bytes. MAX_UPLOAD_MB=1 refused 1,100,000 bytes with 413 and accepted 900,000 bytes.

Worker stopped: docker compose ps worker doc-engine did not list the worker, a new PDF stayed pending and downloaded intact, then reached ready. Engine stopped: a PDF reached failed after 222 s with /readyz 200. A new PDF after the restart reached ready.

Signing updates offered Polling (outbound access only) and Webhook (public HTTPS gateway and Connect subscription). The AI analysis Provider card offered Test connection. No provider credential was used.

Behind the proxy, sign-in answered 403 INVALID_ORIGIN until BASE_URL named the proxy origin. Then sign-in, an invitation link with that origin, its acceptance and the invited sign-in worked. A buffering and compressing proxy held back a comment frame for the 20 s window. Without buffering it arrived in 19 ms.
The log scan found none of 10 known secret values and no relay URL with credentials.
